title: Fresenius
summary: German healthcare group with dialysis, infusion and hospital businesses.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Fresenius operates dialysis clinics, makes infusion and nutrition products, and supplies hospital services through its operating companies. Its dialysis business is a large, stable procedure-driven franchise, while its other units are being restructured. Reimbursement and demographic trends drive demand.

Technology Exposure

  • Dialysis products and clinics
  • Infusion and nutrition therapies
  • Hospital services

What To Watch

  • Dialysis reimbursement
  • Restructuring progress
  • Emerging-market growth

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
